scope: A bound on the tracker's half-pixel convention mismatch over every tracking frame of the 129 registered runs. Simulation with exact depth. Nothing is changed or replayed.

conventions.tracker: source/isaaclab_pruning/isaaclab_pruning/perception/visual_servo.py project_depth_to_world back-projects the OpenCV pixel with no offset
conventions.seed: hpc/inner/render_pruning_workflow.py seeds the tracker with the continuous projection K X / Z

reading: The offsets are upper bounds of a fixed half-pixel ray shift, not measured tracking errors. Changing the tracker to u + 0.5 would change every baseline replay, so it belongs in a labelled, registered arm.
